interpretation: Only a unique eligible log is matched. Unmatched, ambiguous, or excluded sleep remains missing; it is never converted to zero.
sleep_alignment_rule: Use episode end calendar date as the waking-date candidate. Eligible logs must end before noon, start at/after 18:00 or before 06:00, span no more than 12 hours, have exact 60-second intervals, not overlap, and be the only candidate log for that participant-waking date.
